target_customer: Business users in companies that want to query data in plain language
problem: Non-analysts cannot easily get answers from data. Askdata let users ask questions in natural language and translated them to SQL over connected sources.

technical_complexity.rationale: Translating natural language into SQL against live sources in 2019 was a hard NLP problem for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: NLQ features were being added by BI vendors, so a standalone layer was easy to substitute.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: SAP acquired Askdata on 2022-07-21 to fold the IP into SAP Business Technology Platform for SAP Analytics Cloud, terms undisclosed.

market_need_then: No dated demand evidence opened beyond the product pitch on the YC page.

branding.domain_note: Uses askdata.com. Trademark ASKDATA filed Sep 2019 by INNAAS S.r.l. per a trademark record, suggesting an Italian parent entity.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name that collides with Tableau Ask Data and other products, no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Askdata entered YC in Winter 2019 and was bought by SAP in July 2022, with the technology going into SAP Analytics Cloud. Funding visible was small, so the exit looks like a technology buy by a strategic acquirer. Details on traction, price and team are missing.
notes: askdata.com fetch returned 503. Seedtable lists a 258K seed on 2019-01-15 with YC, TIM Ventures and Pi Campus, Bouncewatch totals 321K, aggregators only so no round recorded. Location conflicts: YC says San Francisco, press says Rome. Competitor search returned only current pages, so the dated list is empty. Update: the seed rests on a single database (Seedtable); CB Insights totals $250K over 8 rounds and Bouncewatch $321K over 5, not summed. SAP acquisition is reported by FinSMEs and others with no price.
